simple_identification_1: Scanned and photocopied documents are not accepted for verification.
simple_identification_11: Information on the documents provided must not be hidden.
simple_identification_12: All characters and digits, as well as the face on the photos, must be visible.
simple_identification_2: Fill in the registration form with your details exactly as they appear in your passport.
simple_identification_4: In the ”Photo of passport” section, upload a color photo of the main double-page spread in your passport. The photo must not be cropped. The double-page spread must be photographed in full. All characters and digits must be visible and easy to read.
simple_identification_5: In the ”Photo of proof of address” section, upload a color photo of your registration information (residential address) in your passport. The photo should not be cropped. The document number at the bottom of the page must be visible. All characters and digits must be visible and easy to read.
simple_identification_6: For identity verification, please provide the following documents:
simple_identification_7: In the ”Photo with passport” section, upload a color photo of yourself holding your passport open (main adjacent page) in your hands next to your face. Photos in mirror image are not accepted. Information in the document must be clearly visible in the photo.
simple_identification_8: In the ”Photo of TIN” section, you must upload a photo of an official document confirming your personal tax information. The document should be fully visible in the photo and all characters and digits must be visible and easy to read. If you do not have a hard copy of documentation containing your TIN information, you can upload a screenshot from the Federal Tax Service website which shows your details and TIN. Screenshots from mobile devices are not accepted for verification.
simple_identification_id_description: Upload a color photo of your passport open on the information page. Your photo must not be cropped and the entire two-page spread must be fully visible. All text and numbers must be visible and clearly legible
simple_identification_id_photo_descripti: Upload a color photo of you holding your passport open on the information page next to your face. Mirrored photos will not be accepted. Your passport details must be clearly visible in the photo
simple_identification_inn_description: Upload a photo of your certificate of registration with a tax authority as a private individual. The document must be fully visible and all text and numbers must be clearly visible and legible. If you do not have a paper document with your TIN information, you can upload a screenshot from the website of the Federal Tax Service with your information and your TIN. Screenshots from mobile devices will not be accepted
simple_identification_residence_place_de: Upload a color photo of the registration page (address page) of your passport. Your photo must not be cropped and the document number at the bottom of the page must be visible. All text and numbers must be visible and clearly legible
